The '''Separatist boarding craft''' was a [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding craft]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used one of these ships to [[Capture of the Mon Calamari ship|board]] a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Mon Calamari capital ship (Clone Wars)|ship]]. The boarding craft was able to carry [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|destroyer droids]].<ref name="SW:GG" />
